title: Natural coefficient-universe comparison for quasi-coherent etale cohomology
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact separated scheme and F a quasi-coherent module. Set E=F_et [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module] and let L be sectionwise ULift to coefficient universe u+1. For every q>=0 there exists an additive equivalence H^q(X_et,L(E)) -> H^q(X_et,E), with the small-coefficient group computed using HasExt.standard, commuting with every abelian sheaf endomorphism theta:E->E. The same equivalence works for all theta, and no preservation of injectives by ULift is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03P2, separated-case finite affine open cover argument, naturality on one fixed cover.

proof.text: Fix a finite affine open cover. Intersections are affine by separatedness, and ordinary and lifted affine quasi-coherent acyclicity annihilate all positive rows of the Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence.

In each degree lower the finitely many components. This commutes with restrictions, alternating differentials and theta, so identifies cocycles, coboundaries and homology naturally. Compose with the natural Cech edge maps and reindex Ext via homAddEquiv. For q=0 use sections and AddEquiv.ulift. Empty X and F=0 have zero complexes.

theorem exists_etaleTensorSectionsSheaf_cohomology_ulift_natural
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [X.IsSeparated]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ) :
    let E := etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F
    let L := sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}
    ∃ e : Sheaf.H (L.obj E) q ≃+
        @Sheaf.H _ _ X.smallEtaleTopology E inferInstance (HasExt.standard _) q,
      ∀ (θ : E ⟶ E) (x : Sheaf.H (L.obj E) q),
        e (Sheaf.H.map (L.map θ) q x) =
          @Sheaf.H.map.{u + 1, u, u, u + 1} _ _ X.smallEtaleTopology
            inferInstance (HasExt.standard _)
            _ _ θ q (e x)
